_help: Named rivalries, shown as featured cards on the Rivalries page in this order. managers: two manager IDs from managers.json. name is optional; description is one or two sentences.

rivalries.description: One title each, in back-to-back years: Keith in 2022, Kyle in 2023. Keith took the first ESPN meeting by 6.94 in week 5, so Kyle lost the tiebreaker by less than one decent kicker game.
In 2023 Brandon went 2-12 and still finished three spots ahead of Reis. Reis got revenge with a 43.64-point win in week 1, the biggest margin in the series, which is also the entire series.
Eight playoff trips between them, three runner-up finishes, zero titles. Tyler won the first meeting 186.28 to 127.90, so the bridesmaid pecking order is settled, for now.
Josh's best finish is 5th, Noah's is 6th, and both have a last-place season on the resume. Josh won the first meeting 130.64 to 99.34, so for once OMM is ahead of somebody.
In 2025 Cody went 10-4 and finished 5th while Brett went 7-7 and won the whole thing. Cody hung 180.28 on the commissioner in week 3, which doesn't get the banner back but is a start.
